items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I don't know whether Baby Dodge was playing drums then. He didn't have Baby Dodge on the drums.

ctx.x: When did you first hear Oliver that you can remember?

Oh, I think it was around 1917 at Tulane Gym. They gave subscription dances every Saturday night at Tulane Gym. And every time they could get him, they got him. Yeah. And they got him for everything else they could get him for too. He had the cream of the crop. He had Kidore on trombone, Johnny Dodge on clarinet. And I don't know whether Baby Dodge was playing drums then. He didn't have Baby Dodge on the drums.
No, I think he used different people like Red Happy, they called him.
